name: J.A.R.V.I.S - Run a multi-tool personal AI agent in Telegram with Groq Llama 3.3

parameters.content:
## Run a multi-tool personal AI agent in Telegram with Groq Llama 3.3

### How it works

This workflow creates a Telegram-based personal AI assistant powered by Groq Llama 3.3 70B with eight free tools. When a user sends a message in Telegram, the agent decides which tool to call, executes it, and returns a natural-language response. Window buffer memory keeps context across messages so the agent remembers the conversation.

### What the agent can do

- Search the web for real-time information using Tavily
- Check current weather for any city using OpenWeatherMap
- Find top news headlines using NewsAPI
- Look up facts on Wikipedia
- Perform math calculations
- Return the current date, time, and timezone
- Tell random jokes from JokeAPI
- Read and summarize any URL

## Receive messages

Listen for Telegram messages listens for incoming user messages and passes the chat ID and message text to the AI agent for processing.

## AI agent core

The JARVIS Agent node routes each message to the right tool based on user intent. Groq Llama 3.3 70B powers the reasoning. Window buffer memory stores the last 10 exchanges per chat ID so the agent maintains conversational context across messages.

## Eight free tools

Top row: Web Search (Tavily free tier), Weather Lookup (OpenWeatherMap free tier), News Search (NewsAPI free tier), Wikipedia Search (built-in n8n node).

Bottom row: Calculator (JavaScript math eval), Date and Time (returns current datetime and timezone), Random Joke (JokeAPI, no key needed), URL Reader (fetches and extracts text from any URL).

All APIs used here offer free tiers with no credit card required.

## Send response

Returns the agent output back to the user in the same Telegram chat using Markdown formatting.

## Setup Guide

### Step 1 - Telegram Bot (required)
1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather
2. Send /newbot and follow the prompts to name your bot
3. Copy the bot token BotFather gives you
4. n8n: Credentials - Add - Telegram API - paste token - Save
5. Select this credential in both the Listen for Telegram messages and Reply in Telegram chat nodes

### Step 2 - Groq API Key (required)
1. Go to console.groq.com - API Keys - Create
2. n8n: Credentials - Add - Groq API - paste key - Save
3. Select in the Groq Llama 3.3 70B node

### Step 3 - Tavily API Key (required for web search)
1. Go to app.tavily.com and sign up for free
2. Copy your API key from the dashboard
3. Paste into the Web Search tool node header parameter as x-api-key

### Step 4 - OpenWeatherMap API Key (required for weather)
1. Go to openweathermap.org and sign up
2. Go to API Keys tab and copy your key
3. Paste into the Weather Lookup tool node URL parameter

### Step 5 - NewsAPI Key (required for news)
1. Go to newsapi.org and sign up
2. Copy your API key
3. Paste into the News Search tool node URL parameter

### Step 6 - Activate
1. Click Test Workflow to verify with a Telegram message
2. Toggle Active to keep the agent running 24/7

## Customization

### Add more tools
Duplicate any HTTP Request Tool node, change the URL and description, and connect it to the agent. The agent automatically discovers new tools from their descriptions.

### Change the LLM
Swap Groq for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama by replacing the LLM sub-node. No other changes needed.

### Adjust memory
Change the window size in the Conversation memory buffer node to store more or fewer messages. Default is 10 exchanges.

### Multi-user support
Memory is keyed by Telegram chat ID so each user gets their own conversation history automatically.

### Add Google Sheets logging
Insert a Google Sheets node after the Reply in Telegram chat node to log every conversation turn with timestamp, user, query, and response for analytics.
